name: Meddler
text: On Recruit: change 1 of each rival's resources one for one. +1 follower per rival changed.

name: Landlord
text: On Recruit: +2 white. Round Start: +2 white.

name: Misers
text: Game End: +1 follower per 2 white you hold.

name: Greeters
text: Your On Recruits also give +1 of that member's color.
